content.short: dHealth is a blockchain framework for healthcare, research coordination, data exchange, and incentives.
content.description: dHealth is a blockchain framework focused on secure peer-to-peer interactions between healthcare stakeholders, researchers, institutions, and individuals. The project aims to modernize digital infrastructure for health and science by giving participants a shared network for coordination, value transfer, and trusted data workflows. Its model includes incentives through the DHP token, which can support research activity, provider services, and healthier behavior loops. dHealth fits Cardano as a health-focused blockchain infrastructure use case.
